content.short: Bifrost Wallet is a self-custody mobile wallet built around the Flare and XRP Ledger ecosystems.
content.description: Bifrost Wallet is a self-custody mobile wallet that began in the Flare and Songbird ecosystems and now covers Ethereum and other EVM networks including Hyperliquid. Keys and data stay on the device, with no account held by the provider. The app combines token management with an NFT gallery and a Web3 browser, so dapps such as Uniswap, Compound and Flarefarm open directly inside it. Staking and in-app swaps are available for supported assets.
content.meta: Bifrost Wallet is a self-custody mobile wallet from the Flare ecosystem, now covering Ethereum, Hyperliquid and other EVM networks.
